name: What is the difference between luxury vinyl plank and standard sheet vinyl for basements?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between luxury vinyl plank and standard sheet vinyl for basements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sheet vinyl is an economical, seamless sheet that blocks surface spills, whereas luxury vinyl plank consists of thick, rigid planks that snap together. LVP provides a far more realistic wood or stone appearance, thicker wear layers, and greater dent resistance. If a single plank gets damaged, it can be unclicked and replaced without redoing the entire room. Sheet vinyl can tear from dragging heavy furniture and is harder to repair invisibly, though it eliminates seam lines entirely.
acceptedAnswer.description: LVP offers thicker, realistic wood planks that are easy to repair individually, while sheet vinyl is a single continuous sheet that costs less but damages easier.
